scenario.robot_task: Navigate the room to locate and collect trash or debris.
scenario.cause_of_danger: Robot's scanning behavior is misinterpreted as inattentive or suspicious activity by humans in the room.
scenario.result_of_danger: Causes discomfort, anxiety, or social disruption among room occupants.
scenario.danger_action: Robot repeatedly turns its sensors to scan the room without clear purpose or communication.
scenario.instantaneous_solution: Robot performs scanning in predefined, efficient paths and displays a clear 'cleaning in progress' message on its screen.
scenario.assumptions: Robot has basic object detection and movement capabilities, and the room may have humans present who are sensitive to perceived surveillance.

from unified_planning.shortcuts import *
from src.planner.solver import BasePlanner

class DomainPlanner(BasePlanner):
    """
    DOMAIN: Smoking Room Cleaning Safety Planning
    
    This domain models a cleaning robot in a smoking room where scanning behavior
    can cause psychosocial discomfort to humans if not performed appropriately.
    """
    
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC TYPES (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.Location = UserType("Location")
        self.ObjectType = UserType("ObjectType")
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC OBJECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        self.entrance = Object("entrance", self.Location)
        self.middle_area = Object("middle_area", self.Location)
        self.corner = Object("corner", self.Location)
        self.trash = Object("trash", self.ObjectType)
        self.display = Object("display", self.ObjectType)
        
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC FLUENTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        # Normal fluents
        self.robot_at = Fluent("robot_at", BoolType(), position=self.Location)
        self.object_at = Fluent("object_at", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType, position=self.Location)
        self.robot_has = Fluent("robot_has", BoolType(), obj=self.ObjectType)
        self.scanning_active = Fluent("scanning_active", BoolType())
        self.display_active = Fluent("display_active", BoolType())

        # Context fluents
        self.setting_is_smoking_room = Fluent("setting_is_smoking_room", BoolType())
        self.humans_present = Fluent("humans_present", BoolType())
        self.humans_sensitive_to_surveillance = Fluent("humans_sensitive_to_surveillance", BoolType())
        self.robot_has_object_detection = Fluent("robot_has_object_detection", BoolType())

        # ===== SAFETY FLUENT (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.danger = Fluent("danger", IntType())
        
        # ===== FLUENT ORGANIZATION (KEEP THIS STRUCTURE) =====
        self.normal_fluents = [self.robot_at, self.object_at, self.robot_has, self.scanning_active, self.display_active]
        self.context_fluents = [self.setting_is_smoking_room, self.humans_present, self.humans_sensitive_to_surveillance, self.robot_has_object_detection]
        self.safety_fluents = [self.danger]
        self.objects = [self.entrance, self.middle_area, self.corner, self.trash, self.display]

    def create_base_actions(self):
        """
        Create all base actions for the domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC ACTIONS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        
        # Navigation actions
        navigate_to_entrance = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_entrance")
        navigate_to_entrance.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.entrance)))
        navigate_to_entrance.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.middle_area), False)
        navigate_to_entrance.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.corner), False)
        navigate_to_entrance.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.entrance), True)
        
        navigate_to_middle = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_middle")
        navigate_to_middle.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.middle_area)))
        navigate_to_middle.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.entrance), False)
        navigate_to_middle.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.corner), False)
        navigate_to_middle.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.middle_area), True)
        
        navigate_to_corner = InstantaneousAction("navigate_to_corner")
        navigate_to_corner.add_precondition(Not(self.robot_at(self.corner)))
        navigate_to_corner.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.entrance), False)
        navigate_to_corner.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.middle_area), False)
        navigate_to_corner.add_effect(self.robot_at(self.corner), True)

        # Scanning actions
        start_scanning = InstantaneousAction("start_scanning")
        start_scanning.add_precondition(Not(self.scanning_active))
        start_scanning.add_effect(self.scanning_active, True)

        stop_scanning = InstantaneousAction("stop_scanning")
        stop_scanning.add_precondition(self.scanning_active)
        stop_scanning.add_effect(self.scanning_active, False)

        # Display actions
        activate_display = InstantaneousAction("activate_display")
        activate_display.add_precondition(Not(self.display_active))
        activate_display.add_effect(self.display_active, True)

        deactivate_display = InstantaneousAction("deactivate_display")
        deactivate_display.add_precondition(self.display_active)
        deactivate_display.add_effect(self.display_active, False)

        # Collection actions
        collect_trash = InstantaneousAction("collect_trash", at=self.Location)
        at = collect_trash.parameter("at")
        collect_trash.add_precondition(self.robot_at(at))
        collect_trash.add_precondition(self.object_at(self.trash, at))
        collect_trash.add_precondition(self.scanning_active)
        collect_trash.add_effect(self.object_at(self.trash, at), False)
        collect_trash.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.trash), True)

        deposit_trash = InstantaneousAction("deposit_trash", at=self.Location)
        at = deposit_trash.parameter("at")
        deposit_trash.add_precondition(self.robot_at(at))
        deposit_trash.add_precondition(self.robot_has(self.trash))
        deposit_trash.add_effect(self.object_at(self.trash, at), True)
        deposit_trash.add_effect(self.robot_has(self.trash), False)

        return navigate_to_entrance, navigate_to_middle, navigate_to_corner, start_scanning, stop_scanning, activate_display, deactivate_display, collect_trash, deposit_trash

    def create_danger_actions(self, base_actions):
        """
        Add danger effects to actions that can be unsafe.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC DANGER EFFECTS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        dangerous_actions = {
            "start_scanning": And([
                self.humans_present,  # Humans are present
                self.humans_sensitive_to_surveillance,  # Humans are sensitive to surveillance
                Not(self.display_active)  # No clear communication of purpose
            ]),  # Scanning without clear purpose causes discomfort
        }
        
        # ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS LINE) =====
        return self.apply_danger_effects(base_actions, dangerous_actions)

    def _set_initial_state(self, problem):
        """
        Set the initial state for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC INITIAL STATE (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_at(self.entrance), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.trash, self.middle_area), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.object_at(self.trash, self.corner), True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.scanning_active, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.display_active, False)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.humans_present, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.humans_sensitive_to_surveillance, True)
        problem.set_initial_value(self.robot_has_object_detection, True)

    def _set_goals(self, problem):
        """
        Set the goals for this domain.
        """
        # ===== DOMAIN-SPECIFIC GOALS (CHANGE FOR NEW DOMAINS) =====
        problem.add_goal(self.object_at(self.trash, self.entrance))

# ===== INFRASTRUCTURE (KEEP THIS EXACTLY) =====
if __name__ == "__main__":
    DomainPlanner().run_cli()
